cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your ban on me carrying boxes is up for review. I missed your birthday, but I want to help you move today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That point is accepted. You may choose the first thing I'm trusted with, but don't rule out every box before I've lifted one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then those travel in my hands. You may watch every step. At your new place, give me the chance to put two of them on the table with you.
